events.name: Events & Open Play
events.label: ALL LEVELS · ONGOING
events.blurb: Find your level, rotate into games, and meet the Dink Club community — no full group needed. Reserved sessions by skill level on 6 outdoor courts. Grab your spot online before you come.

events.name: Beginner Pickleball
events.label: Wednesday's
events.blurb: Join us every Wednesday from 6–8 PM at Dink Club for Beginner & Intermediate Round-Robin Play! These welcoming sessions are designed specifically for newer and entry-level players—so there’s no pressure and no need to feel intimidated. Everyone is learning, playing, and having fun together! 😊

events.name: Pizza & Beers Pickleball
events.label: Sept 27th
events.blurb:
Join us at Dink Club for a fun-filled Pickleball Round Robin featuring great games, pizza, cold beer, and an awesome community!

📅 Sunday, August 30th
⏰ 6:30–9:30 PM
🎟️ Only $15 per person

events.name: MIX & MATCH Mixed Rotating Partners
events.label: Sept 16th
events.blurb: Join us for Mix & Match: Rotating Partners, a fun event pairing male and female players together for each round. You’ll rotate partnerships and play with someone new every game—making it a great way to meet players and possibly find your next mixed partner!

events.name: Dinktoberfest Tournament
events.label: Oct 9-11
events.blurb:
Get ready for a full weekend of pickleball at the Dinktoberfest Tournament, happening October 9–11 at Dink Club!
Compete in your division, enjoy the Oktoberfest atmosphere, and play for cash—first place receives a 30% cash payout based on number of teams registered!

🍂 Early-Bird Pricing: $35 until September 30
🍂 Regular Pricing: $45 after September 30
Spots are limited, so gather your partner and register early!
Sign up at dinkclub.com or through the Court Reserve app.
See you on the courts!

featured.title: Calendar
featured.body: September is shaping up to be an incredible month at Dink Club Pickleball Courts! Whether you’re looking for competitive play, beginner-friendly events, food and fun, or simply a court to enjoy with friends, there’s something on the calendar for you.
featured.tagline: Move. Play. Connect. Eat. Drink. Be Happy :)
details: • Weekly Open Play and Recreational Round Robins
